verdict.rationale: Kong's AI-related features center on AI Gateway (LLM traffic routing/governance) and Insomnia's AI-assisted authoring (mock generation, commit messages), not on generating insights or suggestions from a user's own operational/API data. No evidence of AI-driven analytics, anomaly detection, or data-derived recommendations inside Kong Gateway/Konnect dashboards. Missing for 10: any documented AI-generated insight/recommendation feature analyzing the user's traffic/API data, and independent corroboration of such a feature.
